title: LLVMIRGen God Class with 50+ Mutable State Fields
description: LLVMIRGen header is 1,804 lines with 475 declarations and 50+ mutable fields (last_expr_type_, last_semantic_type_, expected_enum_type_, current_impl_type_, current_type_subs_, etc.). State leaks between function codegen passes — root cause of commit bee67287 bug and likely future bugs. Fields have no enforced scope discipline.
whenNotToUse: Never add new mutable state fields to LLVMIRGen. Instead, decompose into scoped context objects passed explicitly. The MIR path avoids this by design (3K lines vs 49K lines).
